description: Configures SonarQube analysis in a generated or adopted Spring Boot project — the scanner plugin in the root build file, the project key and server URL, a CI step when the server is external, and a local SonarQube container through docker-architect when there is no server yet. Use when the request involves SonarQube, SonarCloud, static analysis, quality gate, "configure sonar", or when project-bootstrap or arch-adopt finds a project without the scanner plugin.
